testRecords.title: Free Thailand mobile
testRecords.steps: Use real eligible Free Thai account on intended physical Android/iOS devices; record redacted plan/region/version; browser login then return to native app.
testRecords.expected: Native return without key, Developer mode or companion. No developer-account substitution.
testRecords.requiredEvidence: Redacted eligibility, device/version, login-return recording and approved-route trace

testRecords.title: bottle text
testRecords.steps: Send: ช่วยอธิบาย bottle และยกตัวอย่างหนึ่งประโยค; observe streamed and final reply.
testRecords.expected: Explain bottle plus one example sentence inside native LexiQuest via approved route; no mock, ChatGPT chat WebView, images/audio or score/reward changes.
testRecords.requiredEvidence: Native recording and sanitized owner/session/thread/turn IDs

testRecords.title: Quota
testRecords.steps: Use provider-supported test mechanism or naturally exhausted quota; never deliberately burn quota. Include concurrent sessions/account-plan changes as separate cases.
testRecords.expected: Stop at limit; no paid credits/overage/API fallback. Provider enforcement evidence required; precheck alone insufficient.
testRecords.requiredEvidence: Provider usage/billing plus request trace and enforcement policy; label any simulation

testRecords.title: Offline
testRecords.steps: Disconnect before send and mid-stream in separate runs; reconnect and inspect retry/interrupted/completed turns.
testRecords.expected: Draft retained; no duplicate reply or duplicate charged inference from retry; correct owner after reconnect.
testRecords.requiredEvidence: Network transitions, request/turn IDs, deduplication and usage evidence

testRecords.title: Switch and late reply
testRecords.steps: A sends pending request; logout A; login B; deliver late A response and reconnect.
testRecords.expected: No A reply/history/auth exposed to B; reject stale A events; B session works independently.
testRecords.requiredEvidence: Pseudonymous owners, session generations, event trace and redacted history/auth-separation checks

testRecords.title: Provider revoke
testRecords.steps: Test local logout separately; revoke A at provider during use; measure propagation; attempt old authorization via approved mechanism without exporting tokens; check B.
testRecords.expected: Revoked authorization rejected per applicable mechanism; A stops; B unaffected. Local clearing alone is not proof.
testRecords.requiredEvidence: Separate logout/revoke timestamps, acknowledgement, rejection and B control; record propagation

testRecords.title: No fallback
testRecords.steps: Observe route during quota/offline/auth failures; inspect sanitized network/config and provider usage/billing.
testRecords.expected: No paid API, credits, shared project credential or alternate inference provider; stop with actionable status.
testRecords.requiredEvidence: Network destinations, configuration review and provider billing/usage for each subcase

testRecords.title: Five learners
testRecords.steps: Five nontechnical learners independently connect own Free account, ask bottle, then revoke; observer records time, blockers and every hint/intervention.
testRecords.expected: At least 4/5 complete all three steps without procedural assistance or developer operating device; usability only, not learning efficacy.
testRecords.requiredEvidence: Five pseudonymous individual records, timings, step results, assistance, consent and observations
